articles.title: South Korea’s Kospi rockets 8% as AI-linked stocks get breather after Jensen Huang’s return as Nvidia CEO. Worst over?
articles.desc: South Korean shares have bounced back sharply after previously hitting a ten-month low, with the KOSPI index climbing 7.19%. This surge was largely driven by a rebound in technology stocks, particularly following Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's return to leadership. Notable AI companies such as Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix recorded substantial gains, while foreign investments showed a positive trend with net purchases totaling 497.3 billion won.

articles.title: Questions linger after Jensen Huang's return to Nvidia

articles.title: Japanese bond yields fall as lower oil prices ease inflation concerns
articles.desc: Japanese government bond yields declined due to falling oil prices that eased inflation concerns. The 10-year JGB yield reached a two-week low of 2.715%. Meanwhile, Japan's benchmark Nikkei 225 index experienced a brief surge of 5% following Nvidia's leadership announcement. Shorter-dated US Treasury yields increased as market stability was reassured by the news. Additionally, markets anticipate a 25-basis-point Federal Reserve rate hike in December.

articles.title: Dollar climbs as renewed AI euphoria fuels Fed hike bets
articles.desc: The dollar is approaching a 20-month peak, thanks to the reinstatement of Nvidia's CEO, which has instilled confidence in the markets. Meanwhile, the euro and sterling struggle against the strong dollar, with the euro hovering near an 18-month low. The market forecasts a Fed rate hike, adjusting to anticipated shifts in monetary policy.

articles.title: Asian stocks rally as Huang's Nvidia return revives AI trade
articles.desc: Asian shares saw significant gains as Nvidia's CEO Jensen Huang made a return that relieved market fears. The MSCI Asia-Pacific index rose by 4.6%, while Japan's Nikkei gained 4.5% after a local holiday. This movement followed a 31.5% surge in Nvidia shares, revealing optimism in the beleaguered AI sector. United States Treasury yields climbed alongside the dollar, signaling increased confidence in Fed tightening measures.

articles.title: Bitcoin fails to hold Nvidia bump with crypto headwinds in focus

With the Federal Reserve's potential rate hikes looming in December, many investors are hesitant, preferring to wait for clearer recovery signals despite attractive buying opportunities at current levels, erasing much of Bitcoin's value since its October 2025 peak.
